# 🧩 Project Templates

Use these templates to make engineering changes reviewable and repeatable. Copy the relevant file, replace every prompt, and remove sections that do not apply.

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Decision Record](adr.md) | Record technical choices and trade-offs |
| [Feature Proposal](feature-proposal.md) | Describe problem, scope, design, and acceptance criteria |
| [API Change](api-change.md) | Specify route and request/response changes |
| [Test Plan](test-plan.md) | Define verification before implementation |
| [Incident Report](incident-report.md) | Capture operational or security incidents |
| [Dataset Register](dataset-register.md) | Record source, rights, classification, and lineage |
| [Model Build Record](model-build.md) | Record reproducible model artifact builds |
| [Release Checklist](release-checklist.md) | Gate a release |
| [Deployment Checklist](deployment-checklist.md) | Verify production deployment readiness |
| [Security Finding](security-finding.md) | Capture private security findings |
| [Technical Debt Item](technical-debt.md) | Track remediation work |
| [Documentation Change](documentation-change.md) | Plan accurate docs and diagram updates |

Do not leave fabricated metrics, sources, approvals, dates, or test results in committed records. Security reports must remain private until disclosure is coordinated.
